4363.title: Turn-start watchdog does not terminate a pending request
4363.rootCauseOneLine: The watchdog warns without settling the pending start; the persisted thread stays active and the actual send service parks follow-up until a synthetic late start dispatches it once. Claude stall remains unverified.
4363.proposedFix: Trace the bridge stall and define cancellation plus late-start handling before making timeout terminal.
4363.caveats: 2026-09-30: two clean same-SHA runs, normal frozen installs/builds, 2 new plus 37 existing tests each. Actual watchdog warning forwarded into migrated server storage; late-start/completion controls are synthetic server events, host command captured only. No live Claude, current UI or full daemon-transport recovery verification.
